newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia rubber closes unchanged in festive lull.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia rubber closes unchanged in festive lull.

text.p: Malaysian rubber prices were quoted unchanged at the close but traders said the market saw virtually no trading with players lost in year-end festivities.
"It's Boxing Day today, tomorrow will be the last day of the week, and next Tuesday will be New Year's eve. What can we expect from the market this time of the year?," said a trader.
The Malaysian Rubber Exchange and Licensing Board (MRELB) quoted market indicator price for January RSS1 buyer at 316.50 cents ($1.25). January SMR 20 buyer was quoted at 309 cents a kg.
For inquirers, trading houses' offer prices remained at December 16's level, with the SMR20 being quoted at 308 cents per kg, SMR CV at 367, SMR L at 349, SMR 10 at 309, and drum latex at 241.
The INRO five-day average was 242.21 Malaysian/Singapore cents per kg on Dec 24 from 242.65 on Dec 23. The daily indicator was 241.69 against 241.26 previously.
